name: Autuskey Bulk Upload
author: Autuskey

sections.description:
Autuskey Bulk Upload simplifies the process of uploading and managing products in your WooCommerce store. With a user-friendly interface, it allows you to efficiently upload multiple products, reducing time and effort.

Features:

  • Bulk upload WooCommerce products with ease.
  • Intuitive and easy-to-use interface.
  • Supports all essential WooCommerce product fields.
  • Compatible with the latest version of WordPress and WooCommerce.

Save time managing your online store by uploading all your products in bulk with this efficient tool.

Support

For support or feature requests, please visit Autuskey Support.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Upload the downloaded zip file and click Install Now.
  5. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  6. Navigate to Bulk Product Uploader in the admin menu to start uploading products.
sections.faq:
What is the minimum WordPress version required?

This plugin requires WordPress version 6.5 or higher.

What is the minimum PHP version required?

This plugin requires PHP 7.4 or higher.

Does this plugin support variable products?

Currently, this version supports simple products. Support for variable products will be added in future updates.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest WooCommerce?

Yes, it is fully compatible with the latest version of WooCommerce.
